description: Get COVID-19 statistics for a specific country by name or ISO code. Returns cases, deaths, recoveries, active, critical, per-million rates, tests, population, and flag. Covers 215+ countries and territories.

country.description: Country name, ISO2 code, or ISO3 code (e.g. "United States", "US", "USA", "Germany", "DE")

strict.description: Use strict name matching instead of fuzzy search (default false)

yesterday.description: Return yesterday's data instead of today's (default false)

name: disease.covid.country

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Country COVID-19 Statistics
